What the Knowledge Retention Agent does
When someone leaves BASF, most of what they know leaves with them. The agent sits down with them before that happens.

Learn the role

The agent pulls together what the person actually did day to day, not just the job title.

→

Write the interview

From that picture it drafts the questions worth asking, tailored to the role.

→

Have the conversation

It runs the interview in chat, asks follow-ups and digs where answers stay vague.

→

Hand over the summary

The result lands in a document shared with the employee and their manager.
